newPlatforms.name: KWDC 93.5 Clean-MP3 Music Submission and Consent Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Stockton, California college radio with worldwide online listening and international submission eligibility not explicitly stated

authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public station mailbox for MP3 music plus a mandatory signed consent form, with a separate optional digital-signature workflow
authorizedRoute.contactPerson: KWDC music-submission team; Leo Marquez is publicly listed as Program Director on the official homepage
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: The official Music Submissions page publishes kwdc@deltacollege.edu in plaintext and explicitly directs music and the completed consent form to that mailbox.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Independent and unsigned-artist music submission for possible KWDC rotation.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Reopen the official page, review and sign the current consent form, select one suitable clean MP3 master, inspect any digital-sign workflow manually, and send one reviewed submission email.

publishedRequirements: use the email subject Music Submission
include sender first and last name
include a professional short message describing the music
include social-media handles and/or a website
attach the signed music consent form or manually complete the linked digital-sign consent workflow and state this in the email
exclude vulgar, discriminatory or explicit content
provide a stereo master at -3 dB
submission does not guarantee selection or a reply
no account login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is published for the canonical email route
safeReviewScope: select one genuinely suitable MarcsMusic track rather than sending a catalogue
confirm the exact master contains only clean and station-appropriate content
review the current legal consent and obtain an authorized human signature
inspect the digital-signature route manually and stop if CAPTCHA, login, session, terms or other protected controls appear
verify that the selected file is MP3 and that the -3 dB master requirement is met without misleading metadata
confirm email attachment-size limits and any bitrate or sample-rate requirements because these are not published
verify sender, artist, song, description, social and website details
confirm the current AI-assisted or AI-generated music policy
retain needs_manual_review until all legal, technical, content and eligibility checks are complete
unresolvedEligibility: whether one or multiple songs may be attached despite the template allowing song title/s
required MP3 bitrate, sample rate, channel mode and metadata fields
whether -3 dB refers to peak, true peak or another mastering measurement
accepted release age or release window
rights, publishing, neighbouring-rights and territorial-clearance declarations beyond the consent form
whether artwork, biography or additional metadata is wanted

optional linked digital music consent signature workflow

activityVerification.evidence: KWDC's official site displayed Summer 2026 programming, student and faculty programming 24 hours daily, a current staff page announcing new producers for fall 2026, live and worldwide online listening, current programme pages and a 2026 award reference.

genreFitEvidence: KWDC states that The Underground Hour plays daily and highlights music from unsigned artists to local and more.
The Summer 2026 schedule states that KWDC plays Latin, Top 40, Rock, Dance and 1980s music within a varied 24/7 format.
The official For the Soul page describes a Friday Hip-Hop, R&B/Soul, unheard-songs and feel-good-songs programme.
Selected clean MarcsMusic electronic, dance, hip-hop, R&B/soul-adjacent or cross-genre material has plausible fit after exact track and content review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KWDC provides a legitimate free email route but requires a signed legal consent form, clean content and a specific MP3 master. A human must review and sign the consent, inspect the optional digital-sign workflow, select and validate the exact clean track, confirm technical and attachment limits, international eligibility, rights, release timing and AI-origin policy, and manually send one reviewed submission.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked before creation for KWDC, kwdc.fm, deltacollege.edu, kwdc@deltacollege.edu and the canonical submission path; no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The public email route, mandatory downloadable consent form and optional digital-signature workflow are stored as one canonical KWDC opportunity. General contacts, staff mailboxes, show-pitch, shout-out, underwriting, IBS, social and third-party routes are excluded.

notes: One new KWDC college-radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The authorized route requires a clean MP3 master and a signed music consent form through a verified public station mailbox. No submission or consent action was performed.
